data.summary: Updated ui/README.md, the only documentation the change made stale. I added two feature bullets (light/dark theme saved in the browser, and privacy mode hiding monetary values and profit figures), a folder-overview entry for the new src/components/ui/ primitives, theme handling in the src/lib/ description, and updated the Header.astro, Summary.jsx and new PrivacyToggle/ThemeToggle component descriptions. LoadingSpinner.jsx is still used by several modals and Details/Investment, so its entry stays. The root README and docs/*.html do not describe the UI in a way the change invalidates, so they were left alone. No CHANGELOG exists, so no changelog entry was added. No OpenAPI spec exists and the HTTP contract is unchanged.

updatedFiles.description: Added theme and privacy-mode feature bullets; documented src/components/ui/ primitives, theme handling in src/lib, Header/PrivacyToggle/ThemeToggle components and the KPI-card Summary.

data.openApiNotes: No OpenAPI or Swagger spec exists in the repository, and the change does not alter any HTTP contract.
followUps: No CHANGELOG.md exists; if the project wants release notes for user-visible UI changes (theme toggle, privacy masking of profit), one could be introduced by a human decision.
